title: Cut over to one composable Sheets vocabulary
summary: Rename the tool family and arguments once, return normalized spreadsheet and range references under the same keys accepted by the next tool, and remove every old name rather than aliasing it.
diff_sketch: Replace the nine gsheet_* registrations with the canonical gsheets_* family; use spreadsheet/range/title/limit inputs and direct snake_case result fields; constrain typo suggestions to canonical gsheets_* names so retired namespaces receive only a generic unknown-tool error; update all first-party policies, citations, catalogs, fixtures, tests, and docs atomically; add no aliases.
risk: Breaking by design; mixed server/gateway versions are invalid, so release and rollback must be atomic.
test_plan: Golden local and broker tools/list schemas, output-to-input composition tests, retired-namespace calls that receive no canonical suggestion, active-tree legacy-name absence checks, and fresh-agent canonical-task simulations.

priority_components.blast_radius_reason: Every Sheets call and every downstream policy/catalog consumer uses this vocabulary.

title: Replace FastMCP wrappers with a strict typed boundary
summary: Use a low-level MCP server and one ToolSpec registry so runtime validation, schemas, annotations, capabilities, and dispatch share the same source of truth.
diff_sketch: Build Pydantic extra-forbid strict input/output models; emit explicit Tool definitions and annotations; serialize validated model instances so required status/operation discriminator defaults are present on the wire; validate arguments without echoing values; return CallToolResult with typed structuredContent and isError; derive CLI capabilities from the same registry.
risk: A direct CallToolResult bypasses SDK output validation, so the registry must validate both success and error models before emission and wire tests must pin behavior.
test_plan: Real stdio MCP initialize/tools-list/tools-call tests, output schemas that reject payloads missing status or operation, unknown-field and malformed-type cases, schema validation of every emitted payload, and credential-free discovery tests.

priority_components.blast_radius_reason: The boundary determines every call's schema, error semantics, and parseability.

triangulation.selected: low-level Server with typed ToolSpec registry
triangulation.rejected: FastMCP default extra-ignore and raw validation formatting

title: Make mutation outcomes and recovery explicit
summary: Classify every mutation failure as not_started, unchanged, uncertain, partial, or restored; retain copy progress; and make recalculation compensating and verifiable.
diff_sketch: Add phase-aware operation errors and retry metadata; retain destination/progress through copy; reject mixed recalculation ranges; remove value logging; for an uncertain clear make the first exact restore the sole bounded compensation write, verify formulas, and never issue a second write after response loss; never advertise unimplemented idempotency.
risk: Google cannot prove all transport-timeout outcomes and Sheets-only scope cannot delete orphan copies; the contract must retain uncertain/partial states rather than hide them.
test_plan: Injected failures before/after each mutating stage, copy progress assertions, formula-only precondition tests, uncertain-clear tests proving exactly one compensation write and no second write after response loss, compensation success/failure tests, and assertions that logs/results never contain snapshots.

priority_components.blast_radius_reason: A bad retry or failed recalculation can duplicate files or alter spreadsheet data.

triangulation.mandatory: mutation state machine and no blind replay
triangulation.excluded: fake idempotency key without durable dedupe

title: Advertise only executable mode-specific capabilities
summary: Broker discovery must omit Drive search, common spreadsheet addressing must behave identically in both modes, and invalid mode values must fail closed.
diff_sketch: Construct the immutable registry from validated startup mode; expose eight broker tools and nine local tools; accept only strict Sheets URLs/IDs in common tools; normalize search results; add gateway closed-world enforcement for the broker policy set.
risk: Local callers that relied on exact-title resolution must use explicit search and select; no title fallback remains.
test_plan: Local/broker tools-list snapshots, invalid-mode startup failure, credential-access sentinels during discovery, URL/ID parity, title rejection, and policy-owner closed-world tests.

priority_components.blast_radius_reason: Capability lies waste calls and can expose an unclassified tool to the gateway.

title: Install an explicit package and CLI contract
summary: Eliminate the generic src import collision and implicit stdio launcher with an installable gsheets_mcp package and self-describing CLI.
diff_sketch: Move code to src/gsheets_mcp, delete run_server.py and the src compatibility package, expose gsheets-mcp serve/help/version/capabilities, derive capability JSON from ToolSpec, and update tracked launch configs and deploy smoke imports.
risk: Every launcher must move to the installed console command in the same cutover; bare invocation intentionally stops serving.
test_plan: CLI stdout/stderr/exit-code tests, neutral-working-directory import, editable/wheel install smoke, command-config assertions, and no run_server/src-package references in active files.

priority_components.blast_radius_reason: All local, production, and risk-module launches depend on the package entry point.

title: Preserve structured errors through the gateway
summary: The gateway must use the new error object to decide respawn/retry, retain outcome/recovery details for the caller, and never replay a mutation merely because the broker session expired.
diff_sketch: Read structuredContent.error.code/retry/outcome; replace broker children for future calls; auto-retry only read-only calls explicitly marked safe+automatic+not_started; pass structured details through gateway errors; retain the generic fallback only for unrelated servers.
risk: Changing global reconnect behavior could affect other servers, so gate retry using server policy/tool class and add Sheets-specific regression coverage.
test_plan: Per-user broker-expiry tests for reads versus every mutation class, non-per-user reconnect tests, structured detail preservation, and no duplicate dispatch assertions.

priority_components.blast_radius_reason: Gateway replay can turn an auth failure into duplicate or destructive external state.

triangulation.automatic_retry: read-only plus explicit safe contract only

title: Pin the live contract in tests, lint, CI, and catalogs
summary: Make schema/result drift a failing check across the MCP wire, package CLI, gateway policy, citation hashing, generated context manifests, and active configuration.
diff_sketch: Replace false-positive lint confidence with registry/schema checks; run pytest and lint in CI for all contract-defining paths; update direct-dict citation fixtures; refresh agent-context artifacts through their generator; add active-tree legacy-symbol guards.
risk: Generated artifacts are large; refresh only canonical active artifacts and do not rewrite archives, completed specs, or session logs.
test_plan: Server full suite, gateway targeted suite, context-manifests check, JSON config parse, linter self-tests, and strict audit artifact validation.

priority_components.blast_radius_reason: Without pinned schemas a future harmless-looking wrapper or SDK upgrade can silently restore the bug.

title: Treat release and rollback as an atomic maintenance cutover
summary: Because compatibility is intentionally absent, source, gateway, policy, configs, and cached catalogs must move and roll back as one versioned unit.
diff_sketch: Update production and local tracked configs to gsheets-mcp serve, add a supersession note and smoke checklist, document gateway drain/restart and schema refresh order, and require whole-unit rollback rather than mixed versions.
risk: This work prepares but does not execute the deployment; a later operator must schedule the maintenance window and verify live OAuth/capabilities.
test_plan: Static config assertions, deploy-helper dry checks, documented pre/post smoke calls, and rollback compatibility matrix review.

priority_components.blast_radius_reason: Infrequent but high-impact: mixed contract versions fail every affected Sheets workflow.
